parish.example_en: Our parish holds a weekend fair on the church lawn.
parish.example_zh: 我们堂区周末在教堂草坪上办集市。

park.example_en: Children flew kites in the park after school.
park.example_zh: 孩子们放学后在公园里放风筝。

part.example_en: I understood only the opening part of that story.
part.example_zh: 那个故事我只读懂了开头的部分。

participant.example_en: Each participant received a medal once the race ended.
participant.example_zh: 比赛结束后，每位参加者都得到了一枚奖牌。

participation.example_en: Your participation made the charity concert a success.
participation.example_zh: 你参加了慈善音乐会，演出因此获得了成功。

partner.example_en: My lab partner held the beaker while I poured.
partner.example_zh: 我的实验搭档扶着烧杯，由我来倒。

partnership.example_en: Their partnership in the bakery has lasted ten years.
partnership.example_zh: 他们在这家面包店的合伙已经持续了十年。

party.example_en: We hung balloons in the hall for a birthday party.
party.example_zh: 我们在礼堂里挂上气球，准备办生日聚会。

passage.example_en: The second passage describes a storm far out at sea.
passage.example_zh: 第二段描写了远海的一场风暴。

passenger.example_en: An elderly passenger offered me a seat on the bus.
passenger.example_zh: 一位年长的乘客在公交车上把座位让给了我。

passion.example_en: Chess is her passion, so she practises before breakfast.
passion.example_zh: 国际象棋是她的热情所在，所以她早饭前都要练习。

path.example_en: A muddy path leads from the back gate to the field.
path.example_zh: 一条泥泞的小路从后门通向操场。

patient.example_en: The patient thanked the nurse after the check-up.
patient.example_zh: 检查结束后，病人向护士道了谢。

pattern.example_en: Those curtains show a pattern of blue birds.
pattern.example_zh: 那些窗帘上是蓝色小鸟的图案。

payment.example_en: Ticket payment for the museum visit is due today.
payment.example_zh: 博物馆参观的门票付款今天就要交。

pea.example_en: A green pea rolled off my plate during lunch.
pea.example_zh: 午饭时，一颗青豌豆从我的盘子里滚了出去。

peace.example_en: The two villages have lived in peace since the agreement.
peace.example_zh: 自从达成协议后，那两个村子一直生活在和平之中。

peak.example_en: She reached the peak of the hill just before noon.
peak.example_zh: 她就在中午前登上了小山的顶点。

penalty.example_en: The striker scored from the penalty in the last minute.
penalty.example_zh: 前锋在最后一分钟罚进了点球。

pencil.example_en: This pencil is too short for the drawing test.
pencil.example_zh: 这支铅笔太短，画画考试不太好用。

pension.example_en: Grandma uses her pension to pay for food and bus fares.
pension.example_zh: 奶奶用年金支付饭钱和公交费。

people.example_en: Lanterns drew people into the square after dark.
people.example_zh: 天黑后，花灯把人们吸引到了广场上。

perception.example_en: After the talk, his perception of the problem shifted.
perception.example_zh: 谈话之后，他对这个问题的看法变了。

period.example_en: During that period, we lived above a small bakery.
period.example_zh: 在那段期间，我们住在一家小面包店的楼上。

person.example_en: The kind person returned my lost wallet yesterday.
person.example_zh: 昨天，那位好心人士把我丢失的钱包还了回来。

personality.example_en: Teams trust him because of his calm personality.
personality.example_zh: 因为他的人格很沉稳，队友们都信任他。

petrol.example_en: We ran out of petrol halfway to the countryside.
petrol.example_zh: 去乡下走到半路，我们的汽油用完了。

phase.example_en: The building is now in the final phase of repair.
phase.example_zh: 这栋楼的修缮现在到了最后阶段。

philosophy.example_en: He lives by a simple philosophy: homework comes before play.
philosophy.example_zh: 他奉行一个简单的哲学：先完成作业再玩。

phone.example_en: My phone rang in the middle of maths class.
phone.example_zh: 数学课上到一半，我的电话响了。

photo.example_en: This photo shows Grandma standing in her garden.
photo.example_zh: 这张照片里，奶奶站在她的花园中。

phrase.example_en: I forgot the French phrase for asking the price.
phrase.example_zh: 我忘了用法语问价格的那个短语。

picture.example_en: A picture of the harbour hangs above our sofa.
picture.example_zh: 我们沙发上方挂着一张海港的图片。

piece.example_en: She gave me a piece of cake after dinner.
piece.example_zh: 晚饭后，她给了我一块蛋糕。

pig.example_en: The pig slept in the shade beside the barn.
pig.example_zh: 猪睡在谷仓旁边的阴凉处。

pilot.example_en: The pilot checked the weather before take-off.
pilot.example_zh: 飞行员在起飞前查看了天气。

pitch.example_en: Because of rain, our match moved onto the indoor pitch.
pitch.example_zh: 因为下雨，我们的比赛改到了室内球场。

place.example_en: This place is quiet enough for evening homework.
place.example_zh: 这个地方很安静，适合晚上写作业。

plan.example_en: Our plan is to visit the zoo on Sunday.
plan.example_zh: 我们的计划是星期天去动物园。

plane.example_en: We missed the bus home because the plane was late.
plane.example_zh: 因为飞机晚点，我们没赶上回家的公交。

planet.example_en: Mars is the red planet shown in our science book.
planet.example_zh: 火星是我们科学书里那颗红色的行星。

planning.example_en: Careful planning kept the picnic dry and cheerful.
planning.example_zh: 规划做得仔细，野餐既没淋雨，大家也很开心。

plant.example_en: The plant by the window needs water twice a week.
plant.example_zh: 窗边那株植物一周要浇两次水。

plate.example_en: He dropped his plate and soup spilled on the floor.
plate.example_zh: 他的盘子掉了，汤洒在地板上。

player.example_en: The youngest player scored the winning goal.
player.example_zh: 最年轻的选手打进了制胜一球。

plot.example_en: The plot twisted when the detective guessed wrong.
plot.example_zh: 侦探猜错的时候，剧情发生了转折。

pocket.example_en: A bus ticket was still in my coat pocket.
pocket.example_zh: 我外套口袋里还剩着一张公交票。

poem.example_en: She wrote a short poem about the autumn moon.
poem.example_zh: 她以秋月为题写了一首诗作。

poetry.example_en: We read poetry aloud beneath the old tree.
poetry.example_zh: 我们在那棵老树下朗读诗歌。

point.example_en: She argued her point until the fare debate ended.
point.example_zh: 她一直论证自己的论点，直到票价辩论结束。

Poland.example_en: My uncle in Poland sent a box of chocolates.
Poland.example_zh: 我在波兰的叔叔寄来一盒巧克力。

police.example_en: The police directed traffic outside the stadium.
police.example_zh: 警方在体育场外指挥交通。

policy.example_en: School policy bans snacks inside the science lab.
policy.example_zh: 学校方针禁止在科学实验室里吃零食。

politician.example_en: The politician answered questions from our class.
politician.example_zh: 那位政客回答了我们班提出的问题。

pool.example_en: The sports hall pool closed after the heavy rain.
pool.example_zh: 大雨之后，体育馆的水池关闭了。

pop.example_en: Speakers at the fair played pop all afternoon.
pop.example_zh: 集市的喇叭放了一下午流行音乐。

population.example_en: Our town's population grew after the new factory opened.
population.example_zh: 新工厂开业后，我们镇的人口增加了。

portion.example_en: I saved a portion of the pizza for my brother.
portion.example_zh: 我留了一部分披萨给弟弟。

position.example_en: On shorter exams, her position never changed.
position.example_zh: 关于缩短考试，她的立场从未改变。

possession.example_en: That old violin is his most treasured possession.
possession.example_zh: 那把旧小提琴是他最珍爱的所有物。

possibility.example_en: Snow on Friday night is a real possibility.
possibility.example_zh: 周五夜里确实有下雪的可能性。

pot.example_en: Soup boiled over in the pot on the stove.
pot.example_zh: 炉子上的锅里，汤沸得溢了出来。

potato.example_en: She mashed a hot potato with butter for dinner.
potato.example_zh: 晚饭时，她把一个热马铃薯加黄油捣成了泥。

poverty.example_en: The novel shows a child's daily life in poverty.
poverty.example_zh: 这部小说写了一个孩子在贫困中的日常生活。

power.example_en: The power failed, so we finished homework by candlelight.
power.example_zh: 电力中断了，我们只好点着蜡烛把作业写完。

practice.example_en: Morning practice on the piano wakes the whole flat.
practice.example_zh: 早上的钢琴练习会把整套房的人吵醒。

prayer.example_en: The family said a short prayer before Sunday dinner.
prayer.example_zh: 一家人在周日晚饭前做了简短的祷告。

preference.example_en: My preference is a window seat on the long train.
preference.example_zh: 我偏爱长途火车上靠窗的座位。

premises.example_en: The bakery premises include a small room upstairs.
premises.example_zh: 这家面包店的房屋包括楼上的一个小房间。

preparation.example_en: Good preparation made the oral exam feel easier.
preparation.example_zh: 准备充分以后，口试就觉得容易些了。

presence.example_en: His presence at the match made the younger players cheer.
presence.example_zh: 他出席比赛，让年轻队员们欢呼起来。

president.example_en: The president visited our city during the holiday.
president.example_zh: 假期里，总统来到了我们这座城市。

press.example_en: Cameras from the press lined the street after the final.
press.example_zh: 决赛结束后，新闻界的摄像机排在街道两旁。

price.example_en: The corner shop raised the price of milk again.
price.example_zh: 街角小店又把牛奶的价格提高了。

principle.example_en: Fairness is a principle our team follows in every game.
principle.example_zh: 公平是我们队每场比赛都遵守的原则。

prison.example_en: The old prison is now a museum beside the river.
prison.example_zh: 那座旧监狱现在成了河边的博物馆。

prize.example_en: First prize was a new bicycle from the shop.
prize.example_zh: 一等奖的奖品是商店里的一辆新自行车。

proceedings.example_en: Court proceedings kept my uncle in the city all week.
proceedings.example_zh: 诉讼让我叔叔在城里待了整整一个星期。

process.example_en: Making paper turned out to be a slow process in art club.
process.example_zh: 在美术社团里，造纸成了一个缓慢的过程。

processing.example_en: Farm workers finish apple processing before sunset.
processing.example_zh: 农场工人在日落前完成苹果的加工。

producer.example_en: The local producer sells honey at the weekend market.
producer.example_zh: 本地生产者在周末市场上卖蜂蜜。

product.example_en: This soap is a product of the village workshop.
product.example_zh: 这种肥皂是村里作坊的产物。

production.example_en: Car production at the factory stopped for the holiday.
production.example_zh: 假期里，这家工厂的汽车生产停了。

profession.example_en: Teaching is the profession she chose after college.
profession.example_zh: 教书是她大学毕业后选择的职业。

profile.example_en: Her club profile lists swimming, art, and music.
profile.example_zh: 她的社团简介里写着游泳、美术和音乐。

profit.example_en: The cake stall made a small profit for our library.
profit.example_zh: 蛋糕摊为图书馆赚了一小笔利润。

program.example_en: The evening program was a concert by our choir.
program.example_zh: 晚上的节目是我们合唱团的音乐会。

programme.example_en: Our class performs in the afternoon programme on Friday.
programme.example_zh: 我们班参加周五下午的那场节目演出。

progress.example_en: Maths no longer scares her because of steady progress.
progress.example_zh: 因为进步稳定，数学不再让她害怕。

project.example_en: The garden project needs soil, seeds, and water.
project.example_zh: 这个花园计划需要泥土、种子和水。

promotion.example_en: Our team earned promotion into the city league.
promotion.example_zh: 我们队晋级进入了市联赛。

proof.example_en: This receipt is proof that I paid for the book.
proof.example_zh: 这张收据是我付过书款的证明。

proportion.example_en: A high proportion of students cycle to school here.
proportion.example_zh: 在这里，骑自行车上学的学生比例很高。

proposal.example_en: Starting a chess club was her proposal to the teacher.
proposal.example_zh: 成立国际象棋社团，是她向老师提出的倡议。

protection.example_en: Sunscreen gives protection on a bright sports afternoon.
protection.example_zh: 晴朗的运动日下午，防晒霜能提供保护。

provider.example_en: Our phone provider repaired the home line before class.
provider.example_zh: 我们的电话提供商在上课前修好了家里的线路。

provision.example_en: One provision in the rules allows water during exams.
provision.example_zh: 规则里有一条规定，考试期间可以喝水。

pub.example_en: Dad met his old classmate at the pub near home.
pub.example_zh: 爸爸在家附近的酒吧遇见了老同学。

publication.example_en: Our school publication printed the winning poems.
publication.example_zh: 我们学校的刊物刊登了获奖的诗作。

publisher.example_en: The publisher donated dictionaries to our library.
publisher.example_zh: 出版商向我们图书馆捐赠了词典。

pudding.example_en: Chocolate pudding was still warm when we sat down.
pudding.example_zh: 我们坐下时，巧克力布丁还是热的。

purpose.example_en: Seeing the pandas was the whole purpose of our visit.
purpose.example_zh: 看熊猫就是我们这次参观的全部目的。

quality.example_en: This bread has better quality than yesterday's loaf.
quality.example_zh: 这面包的质量比昨天那条更好。

quantity.example_en: We bought a large quantity of rice before the camp.
quantity.example_zh: 野营前，我们买了数量很多的大米。

quarter.example_en: A quarter of the apples were too soft to eat.
quarter.example_zh: 这些苹果有四分之一软得不能吃了。

query.example_en: I sent a query because my library card was missing.
query.example_zh: 借书证丢了，我发出了一条查询。

question.example_en: The last question on the maths test used a bus map.
question.example_zh: 数学试卷的最后一道问题用到了一张公交地图。

questionnaire.example_en: Students returned the health questionnaire before lunch today.
questionnaire.example_zh: 学生们今天午饭前交回了健康问卷。

quid.example_en: That comic costs only a quid at the market.
quid.example_zh: 那本漫画在市场上只要一英镑。

rabbit.example_en: A rabbit slipped under the fence and into the garden.
rabbit.example_zh: 一只兔子从篱笆下面钻进了花园。

race.example_en: People of every race cheered at the school concert.
race.example_zh: 学校音乐会上，各个种族的人都在欢呼。

radiator.example_en: The radiator under the window kept the classroom warm.
radiator.example_zh: 窗下的暖气片让教室一直很暖和。

radio.example_en: News on the radio said the football match was cancelled.
radio.example_zh: 收音机里的新闻说足球比赛取消了。

rail.example_en: A loose rail made the train stop outside town.
rail.example_zh: 一根松动的铁轨让火车停在了城外。

railway.example_en: The railway crosses the wide river on a high bridge.
railway.example_zh: 铁路从一座高桥上越过宽阔的河面。

rain.example_en: Heavy rain soaked our school bags on the way home.
rain.example_zh: 回家路上，大雨把我们的书包淋湿了。

range.example_en: The age range in our club is twelve to sixteen years.
range.example_zh: 我们社团的年龄范围是十二岁到十六岁。

rate.example_en: The bus rate for students is half the adult fare.
rate.example_zh: 学生的公交费率是成人票价的一半。

rating.example_en: The hotel's rating fell after a noisy weekend.
rating.example_zh: 吵闹的周末过后，这家旅馆的评分下降了。

reaction.example_en: A big smile was her reaction to the surprise cake.
reaction.example_zh: 面对惊喜蛋糕，她的反应是灿烂一笑。

reading.example_en: Silent reading starts as soon as we take our seats.
reading.example_zh: 我们一坐好，就开始安静阅读。

reality.example_en: Camp felt colder in reality than it looked in photos.
reality.example_zh: 野营的现实感觉比照片里更冷。

reason.example_en: She gave a clear reason for changing the picnic date.
reason.example_zh: 她清楚地说明了野餐改期的道理。

recognition.example_en: He received recognition for his singing after the concert.
recognition.example_zh: 音乐会后，他的歌唱得到了承认。

recommendation.example_en: A recommendation from the coach got him onto the team.
recommendation.example_zh: 教练的推荐让他进了校队。

record.example_en: She set a school record in the hundred-metre sprint.
record.example_zh: 她创下了学校百米短跑的纪录。

recording.example_en: We played the recording of our class choir at home.
recording.example_zh: 我们在家里播放了班级合唱团的录音。

reduction.example_en: A reduction in noise made library study much easier.
reduction.example_zh: 噪音减少以后，在图书馆学习容易多了。

reference.example_en: I keep this atlas as a reference for geography homework.
reference.example_zh: 我留着这本地图册，当作地理作业的参考。

reflection.example_en: The mirror showed a clear reflection of the desk lamp.
reflection.example_zh: 镜子里清楚地映出了台灯的反射。

region.example_en: Visitors come to this region for sweet apples and clean rivers.
region.example_zh: 游客为了甜苹果和清澈的河流来到这个地方。

registration.example_en: Summer camp registration closes at the office on Monday.
registration.example_zh: 夏令营登记将于周一在办公室截止。

regulation.example_en: A new regulation keeps bikes outside the school gate.
regulation.example_zh: 一条新规则要求自行车停在校门外。

relation.example_en: Sleep and test marks show a clear relation in our class.
relation.example_zh: 在我们班，睡眠和考试成绩呈现出明显的关系。

relative.example_en: A relative brought mooncakes from her hometown.
relative.example_zh: 一位亲戚从老家带来了月饼。

relief.example_en: The medicine brought relief from his bad headache.
relief.example_zh: 这药缓解了他那厉害的头痛。

religion.example_en: In his religion, families share a quiet meal on holy days.
religion.example_zh: 按照他的宗教，家人在圣日会安静地一起吃饭。

removal.example_en: Desk removal from our classroom took the whole morning.
removal.example_zh: 从我们教室移除课桌花了整整一个上午。

rent.example_en: We moved to a smaller flat when the rent increased.
rent.example_zh: 租金上涨以后，我们搬进了更小的公寓。

reply.example_en: I am still waiting for a reply from the chess club.
reply.example_zh: 我还在等国际象棋社团的回复。

report.example_en: She gave a report on the class trip to the head teacher.
report.example_zh: 她向校长汇报了班级出行的情况。

representation.example_en: The drawing is a representation of our old school gate.
representation.example_zh: 这幅画是我们旧校门的一种表现。

representative.example_en: Each class chose one representative for the student council.
representative.example_zh: 每个班为学代会选了一名代表。

requirement.example_en: A signed letter is a requirement for joining the camp.
requirement.example_zh: 参加夏令营有一项要求，就是要交签字信。

research.example_en: She won a prize at the fair for research on local bees.
research.example_zh: 她对本地蜜蜂的研究在集市上得了奖。

researcher.example_en: The researcher asked how many hours we sleep at night.
researcher.example_zh: 研究员问我们夜里睡几个小时。

resident.example_en: Every resident on our street recycled glass last month.
resident.example_zh: 上个月，我们这条街上的每位居民都回收了玻璃。

resolution.example_en: Nightly reading for twenty minutes became her resolution.
resolution.example_zh: 每晚阅读二十分钟，成了她的决心。

resort.example_en: The seaside resort was crowded with families in July.
resort.example_zh: 七月里，海滨度假胜地挤满了来度假的家庭。

respect.example_en: We show respect by queueing calmly for the school bus.
respect.example_zh: 我们平静地排队等校车，以此表示尊重。

response.example_en: Laughter was his response when the kitchen lights went out.
response.example_zh: 厨房的灯灭了，他的反应是大笑。

responsibility.example_en: Feeding the class fish is my responsibility this week.
responsibility.example_zh: 这周给班里的鱼喂食是我的责任。

rest.example_en: A short rest on the bench soon cooled us down.
rest.example_zh: 在长椅上稍作休息后，我们很快凉快了下来。

restaurant.example_en: We shared dumplings at a restaurant near the station.
restaurant.example_zh: 我们在车站附近的一家菜馆分着吃了饺子。

restriction.example_en: A restriction on visitors keeps the science lab quiet.
restriction.example_zh: 对访客的限制让科学实验室保持安静。

result.example_en: Teachers posted the vote result on the noticeboard after lunch.
result.example_zh: 午饭后，老师们把投票结果贴在了布告栏上。

retirement.example_en: Dad's retirement party filled the living room with friends.
retirement.example_zh: 爸爸的退休聚会让客厅里挤满了朋友。

review.example_en: A brief review of those dates helped me on the quiz.
review.example_zh: 把那些日期简要复习一下，对我答题很有帮助。

revolution.example_en: Our history book describes the revolution in France.
revolution.example_zh: 我们的历史书描述了法国的那场革命。

reward.example_en: Helping at the fair earned him a reward of free tickets.
reward.example_zh: 他在集市上帮忙，得到的报酬是几张免费票。

rice.example_en: Hot rice and fried eggs were ready when I got home.
rice.example_zh: 我到家时，热白米和煎蛋已经准备好了。

right.example_en: The library sits on the right of the main school gate.
right.example_zh: 图书馆在学校大门的右边。

risk.example_en: There is a risk of ice on the bridge tonight.
risk.example_zh: 今晚桥上有结冰的风险。

river.example_en: We fished in the river behind my uncle's house.
river.example_zh: 我们在叔叔家后面的河流里钓鱼。

road.example_en: The road into the village is narrow and very bumpy.
road.example_zh: 进村的马路又窄又非常颠簸。

rock.example_en: They climbed a large rock during the geography outing.
rock.example_zh: 地理郊游时，他们爬上了一块大岩石。

role.example_en: My role in the school play is the station master.
role.example_zh: 我在校园剧里的角色是站长。

root.example_en: A thick root has cracked the path beside the old tree.
root.example_zh: 一条粗根把老树旁边的小路撑裂了。

rose.example_en: Mum put a yellow rose in a glass of water.
rose.example_zh: 妈妈把一朵黄玫瑰花插进了一杯水里。

round.example_en: We lost the opening round but won the quiz final.
round.example_zh: 我们输了开头的回合，却赢下了问答决赛。

route.example_en: This route avoids the busy junction near the market.
route.example_zh: 这条路线避开了市场附近拥挤的路口。

row.example_en: Our class sat in the second row for the concert.
row.example_zh: 我们班坐在音乐会的第二排。

rubber.example_en: I used a rubber to erase the wrong maths sum.
rubber.example_zh: 我用橡皮把算错的那道数学题擦掉了。

rugby.example_en: They practise rugby on the muddy field behind school.
rugby.example_zh: 他们在学校后面泥泞的场地上练习橄榄球。

rule.example_en: One firm rule says nobody may run beside the pool.
rule.example_zh: 有一条硬规则：谁也不准在水池边奔跑。

salary.example_en: Her monthly salary covers the rent and the groceries.
salary.example_zh: 她每月的薪水够付租金和买菜的钱。

sale.example_en: The winter book sale drew a long queue outside.
sale.example_zh: 冬季图书特卖让门外排起了长队。

salt.example_en: Too much salt ruined the soup we had at dinner.
salt.example_zh: 盐放得太多，我们晚饭的汤全毁了。

sand.example_en: Warm sand stuck to our feet after the sea swim.
sand.example_zh: 在海里游完，温热的沙子粘在我们脚上。

sandwich.example_en: I ate a chicken sandwich on the crowded school bus.
sandwich.example_zh: 我在拥挤的校车上吃了一个鸡肉三明治。

satisfaction.example_en: Solving that hard puzzle gave him real satisfaction.
satisfaction.example_zh: 解开那道难题，让他感到真正的满意。

Saturday.example_en: The street market is busiest on Saturday before noon.
Saturday.example_zh: 街头市场在周六中午之前最热闹。

sausage.example_en: Dad fried a sausage with eggs before leaving for work.
sausage.example_zh: 爸爸上班前用鸡蛋配着煎了一根香肠。

savings.example_en: She spent most of her savings on a second-hand bicycle.
savings.example_zh: 她把大部分储蓄花在了一辆二手自行车上。

scale.example_en: Nobody in town expected a flood of that scale.
scale.example_zh: 镇上没有人料到洪水会有那样的规模。

scene.example_en: The opening scene shows a rainy street at night.
scene.example_zh: 开场的场景是夜晚一条下雨的街道。

schedule.example_en: The exam schedule is pinned beside the classroom door.
schedule.example_zh: 考试日程钉在教室门旁边。

scheme.example_en: The new bike scheme lets students borrow cycles cheaply.
scheme.example_zh: 新的自行车方案让学生能便宜地借车。

science.example_en: In science we heated three metals to see what melts.
science.example_zh: 科学课上，我们给三种金属加热，看哪种会熔化。

scientist.example_en: A visiting scientist showed our class a tiny robot.
scientist.example_zh: 一位来访的科学家给我们班看了一个小机器人。

scope.example_en: Our street survey has a very narrow scope.
scope.example_zh: 我们这条街的调查范围非常窄。

score.example_en: My score on the listening test went up by ten marks.
score.example_zh: 我听力测试的分数提高了十分。

Scot.example_en: A Scot in our hostel taught us a folk dance.
Scot.example_zh: 我们旅舍里的一位苏格兰人教了我们一支民间舞。
